title: Ending an Optional Supplemental Benefit Rider at the Member's Own Request
content:
A member paying for one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders may end it themselves during the call. The rider is closed as ended at the member's own request, the last day it pays for services is recorded, and the rider premium still owed is restated to the closing figure.

## The condition the closing figure waits on

The rider premium left owed when a rider is closed is fixed only once the rider stands suspended for unpaid premium on its own record.

## Ending the rider

The rider is ended with `end_rider_at_member_request_09efad65`. The tool belongs to the member: the representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to end the rider they are paying for.

### Parameters

- `osb_rider_id` — Id class. The reference number of the member's own optional supplemental benefit rider that they are ending, as it stands in the member's rider records.
- `osb_rider_request_id` — Id class. The reference number of the rider service request on which the member's own cancellation was recorded, read from the member's rider service requests.
- `rider_end_date` — Fixed-format class. The last day the rider pays for services, written as a calendar date in four digits for the year, two for the month and two for the day, in that order and separated by hyphens.
- `closing_premium_balance` — Fixed-format class. The rider premium left owed on the rider as it closes, in USD to 2 decimal places, as a plain positive number with no currency sign. It is stored rounded to 2 decimal places, and an amount of zero is written as 0.00.

### What the call does

The rider is closed as ended at the member's own request, the last day it pays for services is recorded as the date given, and the rider premium the member still owes is restated to the closing figure given. The member's medical plan, their allowance card and any other rider are untouched. The rider service request on which the member asked for the cancellation is closed as completed and dated with today's date, so the request no longer stands open. The member's rider record shows the rider ended at their request, the last day it covers them, and what is left to settle.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the rider that has been ended, the last day it pays for services, the rider service request that has been closed as completed, and the rider premium left owed in USD. The sentence being returned at all is what indicates the rider has been ended.

## Basis Q&A

**What happens to the member's other cover?** Their medical plan, their allowance card and any other rider are untouched.

**What becomes of the rider service request the cancellation was recorded on?** It is closed as completed and dated with today's date, so it no longer stands open.

**What does the rider record show afterwards?** The rider ended at the member's request, the last day it covers them, and what is left to settle.
